sources.title: Brewer's Conjecture and the Feasibility of Consistent, Available, Partition-Tolerant Web Services
In Search of an Understandable Consensus Algorithm (Raft)
Dynamo: Amazon's Highly Available Key-value Store

corrections: Qualified 3PC non-blocking behavior by its synchronous-network and restricted-failure assumptions, and removed a fixed 50 percent message-cost claim.
Clarified that a prepared 2PC participant cannot infer abort merely from the absence of a coordinator commit record.
Replaced the simplistic BASE-versus-ACID dichotomy and distinguished ACID consistency from CAP consistency.
Defined CAP availability and consistency closer to the Gilbert-Lynch formulation.
Corrected ZooKeeper semantics to linearizable writes and sequentially consistent local reads, qualified sync(), and fixed the oversimplified leader-election rule.
Limited W+R>N to its actual set-intersection guarantee and removed unsupported Cassandra and DynamoDB linearizability/internal-replication claims.
Corrected Spanner's spanserver/tablet distinction, configurable Paxos replication, TrueTime uncertainty wording, SQL history, and non-fixed commit-wait cost.

add: cap-theorem -> base-theory (context): BASE is an availability-oriented design response, not a theorem consequence.
dist-vector-clock -> crdt (mechanism): causal metadata is used by many, but not all, CRDT designs.
paxos -> dist-spanner (implementation): Spanner uses Paxos groups to replicate tablet state.
dist-2pc -> dist-spanner (composition): cross-Paxos-group read-write transactions use 2PC.
dist-quorum -> gossip (composition): Dynamo-style systems combine quorum operations with gossip/repair mechanisms.
dist-lease -> zookeeper (application): ephemeral/session semantics support lease-like coordination patterns.
removeOrReject: Reject any relation that treats Raft as a prerequisite for Paxos; they are separate consensus presentations.
Reject any relation that equates W+R>N with linearizable or strong consistency.
Reject any relation that treats BASE as the logical opposite of all ACID properties.

openspec: No openspec directory exists; this batch is knowledge-correction maintenance and requires no spec delta.
